items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: Bad Frank had a brother out there, two players.

ctx.x: That's right. The fastest talking about him. See, but he had a band.

What's Bad Frank? Bad Frank had a brother out there, two players. Yeah, I'll see. I'll see. Yeah, yeah, yeah. The violin? I'll see Frank played violin. Yeah. That's who played with the boys. I'll see. I'll see Frank. I'll see Frank. I'll see Frank. I'll see Frank played violin.

Yeah. That's who went to play with the boys, by me, they let me go because I was a kid. I'll see Frank. That was Bad's brother. Yeah. Yeah. And they had the, let me see what other band they had up there. Johnny Brown? Well, Johnny Brown, that's Johnny Brown, that's Way of Lake. Way of Lake. Johnny Brown had a band.
